repos_data.description: MRR tracker for the macOS menu bar — free and open source. One total from Stripe, RevenueCat, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Dodo Payments and Gumroad. No account, no server: your API keys stay in the macOS Keychain.
Universal indie sales tracker for LemonSqueezy, Gumroad, and Stripe. iOS + macOS. 100% on-device privacy.
